entry.text: AT&T(Mexico)
At AT&T, I served as a Senior Business Analyst where I was responsible for bridging the gap between
business stakeholders and technical teams in delivering enhancements to the telecom service
management platform. My role involved gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements for
key features such as keyword management, rebranding workflows, and database optimization. I converted
these requirements into clear user stories and acceptance criteria using tools like Jira and Confluence,
and collaborated closely with developers and QA teams in an Agile environment to ensure timely delivery. I
also created mockups and process flow diagrams to provide visual clarity and validation during requirement
walkthroughs. As part of the UAT phase, I coordinated end-to-end testing, prepared detailed test cases,
and managed defect resolution. I was actively involved in handling change requests, performing impact
analysis, and maintaining requirement traceability throughout the SDLC. Post-deployment, I supported
hypercare activities and facilitated user training sessions to ensure smooth adoption of new functionalities.

entry.text: Citi Bank
• At Citi Bank, I worked as a Business Analyst where I was involved in the enhancement of the bank’s
digital banking platform, focusing on improving user experience, streamlining loan processing, and
ensuring compliance with evolving financial regulations. I gathered and analyzed business requirements
through client interactions and stakeholder workshops, translating them into detailed documentation
including BRDs, FRDs, and user stories with defined acceptance criteria. I collaborated closely with
development teams to design and enhance RESTful APIs used in customer onboarding, loan
management, and transaction processing. In an Agile environment, I actively participated in sprint
ceremonies, managed product backlogs, and ensured clear communication between business and
technical stakeholders. I also played a key role in UAT planning and coordination, creating test cases,
facilitating defect triage, and obtaining business sign-off for production releases. Additionally, I supported
deployment activities using Jenkins and monitored post-release issues during the hypercare phase. My
work contributed to delivering secure, user-friendly banking features while aligning with the bank's
strategic digital transformation goals.Worked as a Business Analyst on digital banking transformation
initiatives, partnering with business stakeholders to define Current State (AS-IS) processes, identify pain points,
and design Future State (TO-BE) operating models aligned with business and regulatory objectives. Collaborated
with business and technology teams on Target Operating Model (TOM) initiatives, supporting operating model
improvements, process standardization, and digital transformation across customer onboarding, loan
management, and transaction processing. Conducted detailed requirement gathering workshops and translated
business needs into BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications.
Performed Business Architecture and Process Architecture analysis by documenting business capabilities, business
processes, system interactions, and end-to-end workflow dependencies to support solution design. Facilitated
